problem: ARIES was not listening to a microphone. `default.audio.source` was an OUTPUT sink, so every pw-record read that sink's monitor: its own loudspeaker feed at -21.6 dBFS against -55.6 dBFS for the room, silence floor exact digital zero, which no microphone produces. Every past 'it heard me' was loopback. Separately, the playback thresholds added 2026-10-01 were dead code (`playing=` never passed, echoes_own_speech never called), and `pick_language()` returned None on weak evidence, letting the decoder roam 99 languages; it answered Macedonian with pt/bg/ro/hr/pl and our own filter discarded the result.
change: voice.py resolves its own capture target and never accepts a sink monitor; source_is_connected() says out loud when nothing is plugged in. The playback thresholds were REMOVED after measurement. Echo rejection against our own last sentence is wired through decode_command and speak_and_remember. pick_language() now forces the better of the user's two languages and forfeits only the vocabulary prompt on weak evidence. aries/flags.py is one place for language and feature flags, readable from env then var/flags.env then defaults, with source_of() reported in artefacts.
validation: Paired on ONE 155 s recording through both module versions, 12 endpointed utterances: false wakes 2 -> 2. The stricter bar caught nothing and cost 2 real commands in 10 at +10 dB SNR, so it was removed rather than kept. Real commands over music, n=10, synthesized and mixed at +10 dB SNR: accepted 3/10 -> 7/10 from the language fix. Capture route, 6 s per cell at volume 0.40: monitor -120.0/-21.6 dBFS, microphone -83.4/-55.6; on the microphone the passage gives 0 of 219 VAD frames over threshold. tests/test_voice_flow.py 68 checks; tests/frozen_mk 469 Macedonian checks.
limitations: THERE IS NO MICROPHONE ATTACHED. Every analog route reads available:no, no USB audio device, capture -82.8 dBFS at 0.70 volume. No end-to-end spoken measurement exists, and the owner's acceptance test — ten minutes of music containing 'Ari', target 0 accepted — CANNOT be executed and is not passed. The 3/10 -> 7/10 uses one synthetic speaker, one SNR, and crude linear resampling 24k->16k; it is a direction, not a WER. The false-wake replay is one recording, so n is 12 utterances.
